description:
Navigate to the 'Explore World Animals' activity in GCompris. This activity is located in the Discovery category (icon with a bottle, magnifying glass, or similar). Once inside, click on different world regions to learn about the animals there. 

Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/world_animals_report.txt' documenting your findings. The file must format entries exactly as: 'Region: [Region Name] - Animal: [Animal Name]'. 

Include a header 'GCompris World Animals Report', list at least 5 different animal-region pairs you discovered, and end with a line 'Total animals explored: [N]'. 

Finally, take a screenshot of the activity showing the map and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/world_animals_screenshot.png'.
